"Win chahiye? Winner jaisa socho."
Motivation action ke baad aati.
"Karo ya na karo. Try naam ki cheez nahi."
Kal ko realize karne ki limit aaj ke doubts hain.
Tumhara samay seemit hai, kisi aur ki zindagi jeene mein barbaad mat karo.
Khamoshi se mehnat karo, success shor machaye.
Kar do—make it happen.
"Success good judgment ka result hai."
Mindset altitude decide karta hai.
Success earned hoti hai, wished nahi.
Waves rok nahi sakte, surf seekh sakte.
Lakshya haasil karne se jo milta hai, usse zyada mahatvapurn hai ki tum kya ban jaate ho.
Future unka hai jo aaj prepare karte.
